title: Recording: Hold Me Tight by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Wings finished recording the Red Rose Speedway song ‘Hold Me Tight’ on 4 October 1972.

The backing track had been recorded in seven takes on 15 September. On this day Paul McCartney overdubbed an organ part, and McCullough overdubbed more electric guitar.

‘Hold Me Tight’ is the only Paul McCartney composition to share a title with a Beatles song.
